items.title: Doordash Just Dropped 16% in a Month. Is It Time to Sell or Load Up?

items.title: ‘We Screwed Up’: DoorDash Stock Rises After Admitting It Underpaid Delivery Workers
items.summary: Food delivery service  DoorDash  has settled a dispute with New York City over claims it underpaid its tipped workers.  More than 200,000 Dashers, as the firm’s delivery workers are called, will receive the payments.  “After years of corporate greed and impunity, we are holding DoorDash to account,” New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani said of the settlement, which he called  “a major victory for the working people who call New York City home.”
